basic_info.description: Imagine waking up to lush green views every day in the heart of the Inner Richmond! This exceptional Edwardian full floor house like flat on the exclusive Funston Greenbelt offers an extraordinary living experience with incredible space and modern comforts.    This home boasts 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms,a 2nd media room/family room and an expansive sunroom   ( perfect light filled office space, yoga studio or, painters retreat?) opening onto the lush backyard, providing plenty of room to spread out, work from home, or simply relax. Enjoy the sophisticated living room with its inviting fireplace and custom built-ins, overlooking serene greenery. The updated kitchen is a entertainer's delight, featuring sleek granite countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, an abundance of cabinets and a generous pantry. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout, leading you to the spacious bedrooms and two full baths. This exceptionally large flat opens on to a lovely shared garden offering a peaceful escape, and deeded storage adds ultimate convenience.The location is ideally located within a block to transportation and great restaurants and shopping on Clement Street, a few blocks to Mt.Lake Park, the Presidio and Lake Street(slow st) VERY easy street parking along the greenbelt
